Feedback.title: SoilWise Feedback Submission
Feedback.description: Public product validation, farming background, and waiting list submission from farmers and agricultural stakeholders.

language.description: User interface language when feedback was submitted (en, ha, yo, ig).

isFarmer.description: Whether the respondent is a farmer.

soilTested.description: Soil testing experience (Yes, No, I am not sure).

soilTestMethod.description: Method or service used to test soil.

otherSoilTestMethod.description: Specification for other soil testing method.

weatherInformationSource.description: Primary channel used for rainfall or weather information.

otherWeatherInformationSource.description: Specification for other weather information source.

farmDecisionChallenge.description: Open-ended response describing biggest farm decision challenge.

likesSoilwise.description: Overall experience response (Yes, Somewhat, Not yet).

removeOrModify.description: Features or elements to change or remove.

joinWaitingList.description: Whether respondent joined the early access list.

UserProfile.title: SoilWise User Profile
UserProfile.description: Public user profile and account metadata.

profile.description: User preferences: preferredLanguage, farmingExperience, primaryFarmingInterest, farmingInterests, preferredCrops.

activeFarmId.description: Identifier of currently active or selected farm profile.

FarmProfile.title: SoilWise Farm Profile
FarmProfile.description: Farmer-owned farm entity with location, derived agro-ecology, and management metadata.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

name.description: Farmer-given name for the farm (e.g. My Main Farm).

location.description: Geographic location containing coordinates, state, LGA, and optional address.

ecology.description: Agro-ecological zone derived from verified SoilWise location classification.

FarmAnalysisRecord.title: Saved Farm Analysis Snapshot
FarmAnalysisRecord.description: Historical snapshot of a completed soil, climate, and crop variety recommendation assessment.

analysisId.description: Unique identifier for this analysis snapshot.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

farm.description: Location, coordinates, state, LGA, and agro-ecology.

soil.description: Soil inputs, provenance, texture, and multi-depth evidence.

climate.description: Seasonal rainfall forecast, duration, and climatological normals.

recommendation.description: Deterministic decision object, top crop, variety, and matching factors.

versions.description: Decision rule, IAR dataset, and schema versions active at analysis time.

fullAnalysis.description: Complete raw FarmAnalysisResult payload for 100% faithful historical reopening.

/soilwise_feedback/{feedbackId}.description: Collection of all SoilWise AI feedback submissions. Public write-only, admin read/manage.

/users/{uid}.description: User profile collection. Users can read and update their own profile; admins can read and manage all profiles.

/users/{uid}/analyses/{analysisId}.description: User-owned immutable historical farm analysis snapshots. Private to owner, read/create/delete by owner, read by admin.

/users/{uid}/farms/{farmId}.description: User-owned farm profiles. Private to owner, read/create/update/delete by owner, read by admin.

/users/{uid}/learning/{docId}.description: User-owned learning journey progress, active lesson tracking, and completed modules.

/learning_lessons/{lessonId}.description: Curriculum lessons for SoilWise Learning Hub. Public read, admin create/update/delete.

/marketplace_seeds/{seedId}.description: Certified crop seeds inventory library. Public read, admin create/update/delete.

/marketplace_orders/{orderId}.description: Farmer crop seed orders and kilogram reservations. Owner/admin read, public create, admin update/delete.
